motifs.name: central_peak_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant top-center blue-green mountain massif: stacked rounded peaks rising from mist, with layered contour strokes, dark ink ridges, mineral-blue washes, and small tree clusters along the lower slopes.
must_preserve: arched layered contour linework on each peak
blue-green mineral wash with tan exposed rock transitions
